name: openbb_economic_indicators
description:
One economic indicator series for a country through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.indicators).
Returns: {indicator, provider, data_points, truncated, data: [records with date, symbol, country, value]} or {indicator, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol (provider code; default CPI); country (two-letter code; default US); frequency (annual, quarter or month; default quarter); limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (econdb, imf; default econdb).
Codes: openbb_economy_available_indicators (imf codes look like dataflow::identifier). FRED series: fred_custom_series. Keys: econdb, imf need none.
Example: {"symbol": "GDP", "country": "DE", "frequency": "annual"}

symbol.description: Indicator code of the provider, e.g. CPI, GDP, URATE (econdb)

country.description: Country code, e.g. US, DE, JP

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
